Model family: Traditionnelle. Reference: 82172/000R-9382. Movement: manual (Caliber 4400 AS). Case material: gold (rose gold). Bracelet: leather. Confidence ~0.7.

Note: the dial has a railroad minute track and applied gold baton indices — that matches ref 82172/000R-9382? Let me think. 82172/000R-9382 has baton hour markers and small seconds at 6. There are variants: 82172/000R-9813 (with Roman numerals?), 82172/000R-9888 (Small seconds with hand guilloché). Actually, 82172/000R-9382 is the pink gold Traditionnelle small seconds 38mm with baton markers and silvered opaline dial. Yes, that seems right.

Could also be 82172/000R-9888 which has a different dial texture. The 9382 has "coach" style... Let me just answer 82172/000R-9382 with confidence 0.55.

Actually the movement caliber 4400 AS is manual winding. Good.

Note case diameter 38mm. Patrimony? No, VC Traditionnelle.
